verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes explicitly supports running commands/interactive shells (modal-docs-13, modal-docs-15), CLI management of running containers (modal-docs-18), custom images with any dependency (modal-docs-2), and filesystem access (modal-docs-8), with community hands-on use (self-hosted runners, gRPC control) corroborating real-world execution of arbitrary workloads (modal-comm-1, modal-comm-2). missing for 10: explicit documented example of installing packages at runtime (e.g., pip install inside a running sandbox) rather than only at image-build time, and independent third-party benchmarking of shell command execution reliability.
